title: moehringia dasyphylla subsp. sedoides
intro: Moehringia dasyphylla subsp. sedoides, commonly known as Alpine Sandwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. Alpine Sandwort is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents present in Alpine Sandwort have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic uses.
